A new Economist/YouGov poll released Sept. 22 found Trump's approval rating fell five points in a single week, from 40% to 35%, wiping out five straight weeks of gains. The drop leaves him just two points above the lowest rating he's ever recorded in the survey and comes as Republicans enter the final stretch before November's midterm elections. [...] The findings underscore challenges for Republicans nationally even as the party continues to benefit from fundraising advantages and support in many conservative states. Democrats, meanwhile, are hoping voter dissatisfaction with the administration can help them regain ground in Congress.

results.content: Earlier in the same week, a Sept. 22 Economist/YouGov poll placed Trump's approval at 35%, a five-point drop in a single week that erased five consecutive weeks of gains in that survey, according to USA Today. Tariffs drew his weakest marks in that poll, with 32% approving of his handling of the issue.
